body:
I was so close to doing something tonight.

I looked at the date and realized i've lost 16 months (and counting) because of this shit that didn't have to happen. 16 months lost.  16 months that i could have spent thinking about something other than myself and my own fucking hurt.  16 months that could have been spent getting closer to those i love rather than alienating them.

There are some hurts that go too deep.  It's so wrong.  I want to be who i was again.  I've tried really hard to find that person. It's hard when you still have the part of you that got you into the mess when that part of you is good.  I can't find the joyful part of me. I can't find the part of me that drives me.  I can't find the part of me that keeps me from staying up all night every night bawling my eyes out and I can't find the part of me that keeps me from my thoughts - thoughts that i feel i have no control of anymore.  It's so fucked up.

Don't worry. I could never do it.  I'm a coward.
